newsitem.title: UK: London silver fixes slightly up at 473.25 cents.
newsitem.headline: London silver fixes slightly up at 473.25 cents.

text.p: SILVER - Fixed at 473.25 cents vs 472.50 cents previously. Fairly quiet and like gold in shadow of PGMs.
PLATINUM - Steady at $440.00/$450.00 up $13.00. Virtually no forward quotes. Cash business strapped for metal.
PALLADIUM - Slightly firmer at $234.00/$244.00. Extremely tight and limited to cash business.
GOLD - $340.60/$341.10 down $1.50. Lease rates sharply higher.
